from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 11:15 2022 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 07 - 10 July 2022 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the Williams Racing team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the fourteen hour period which commenced at 19:30 on 07 July, eighteen hours before the scheduled start time of P1 and ends four hours before the scheduled start time of P1 at 09:30 on 08 July. This was the second of the six individual exceptions permitted for the Williams Racing team during the 2022 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
